featured_reviews.name: Radhika Mehrotra
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely stunning heritage shoppe!! The owners are father and son who have had this shoppe in their family for over 80 years. It was the most lovely experience with my mom getting to learn about their craft and seeing the most beautiful all things silver imaginable. Their silver is pure, of the higest quality and they rightfully take so much pride in each of their creations. They have their own artisans that both, procure and craft the most beautiful pieces. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

featured_reviews.review_text: If Google allowed me to give more than 5 stars, I would gladly give them all to Prema at Tanishq! We came in to purchase a gold chain, and from the moment we sat down, she welcomed us with such overwhelming love, care, and an incredibly friendly warmth. It felt less like shopping and more like being guided by a dear friend. Her patience, sweet nature, and sheer dedication to making us happy left us absolutely spellbound. It was the most pleasant, satisfying, and joyous experience we’ve ever had. Thank you, Prema, for being the absolute brightest gem at Tanishq!

featured_reviews.review_text: My mum and I frequently buy silver jewellery from Silver Palace - we came across their account on Instagram. Their product quality is excellent - the workmanship on the jewellery is very good, and they are upfront about the stones they use on the jewellery, the weight of each piece and how it impacts pricing. They have a wide collection, are very responsive on WhatsApp, and they will send photos of whatever jewellery you want to see. They are also very honest - we once accidentally transferred money to their account instead of someone else, and Dakshay at Silver Place promptly sorted out the matter for us. I plan to visit their Colaba store soon, so will update this review after that! Would happily recommend them to anyone looking to buy good quality silver jewellery.

featured_reviews.name: Pranita Eunni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Editing again few hours later on 31/12/2024:

Reached out to the shop via Instagram, they were patient enough to interact, but seem to not agree about having told us the statue was of 70 gms.
They gave us some breakdown for the prices too and even had a call, but  In the end it was our word against theirs.

Hence, lesson learnt please ask them to weigh your stuff and give you clarity on the rates and making charges etc to avoid this back and forth.

However, I must say they are very quick to respond and have done their best to provide clarity and even agreed to take back the piece when we are back in india if we are not satisfied and not using it. So they do win brownie points for customer service.

Editing it on 31/12/2024
We got scammed quite a bit, we were told the shiva statue we purchased was of 70 gms while in reality it only weighed 43 gms, and same with the jewellery that we purchased, all in all we ended up paying for  90 gms of silver, while we were sold c.50 gms of silver., even with the making charges and wastage we shouldn't have been charged what we were charged. Lesson learnt, ask these people to weigh the item in front of you, please be cautious...I am now worried if we were even sold pure silver, need to get it tested

My original review post purchase on 30/11/24

Excellent options to choose from,the people running the business were very helpful too

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
My journey with this store started 2.5 yrs ago on Akshay Tritiya and I am glad to say that I have found the best store and the best team for jewelry shopping. Mrs. Neetu Singh, who is the store manager is a gem of a person. She has answers to all my questions and has a lot of patience to deal with the clientele while there is a lot of pressure from every corner. Moreover, she has become like a family member for us. Be it replacing old designs with new designs or trying to find the right time to buy or sell jewelry, she always provides with the best suggestions. My very first experience was delightful when she helped me find the exact ring design I had in my mind. The design of the ring was applauded by my colleagues in the U.S. who were also persuaded to buy gold from this store.

Coming to her team members, Ms. Tanuja is a cheerful person who always greets us with smile and ensures to give ample time to us showing different designs in different categories. She also keeps us informed about new deals in the store through messages and checks in via calls. It is because of Tanuja’s efforts and hospitable nature that we get convinced to buy something on Diwali from last 2 yrs and I am sure the same will happen this year too. I met both Tanuja and Neetu through my maasi. They love my maasi and it was heart-touching to see that they remembered my Maasi’s birthday recently and surprised her with a delicious cake when we visited the store 2 weeks ago. The other good thing is that the team is understanding of our budget and doesn’t forces us to go overboard.

Recently, we went to get some melting done and Mr. Jayant completed the whole melting project patiently. The process was transparent and it was made sure that we were aware of all the necessary details. Mr. Sudhanshu was also helpful in the whole process and clarified our doubts about weight and next steps.

Lastly, I would like to applaud Mr. Shivam Pandey who took his time to bring out the best bracelet designs for me and other jewelry designs for my maasi. He is a joyful and fun person to talk to and is skillful with keeping the client’s attention intact to his sales pitch and getting the deal closed. My maasi had a major spine surgery 3 months ago and the team is always careful and considerate that my aunt should be comfortable with her movements. They make sure she doesn’t move much yet she can enjoy the thrill of jewelry shopping by bringing all the designs in any category at one table. Mrs. Neetu always sends us home with wonderful gifts as a token of love and our bond keeps growing infinitely.

featured_reviews.name: ravi jethva
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Tanishq Andheri West store on Akshaya Tritiya to buy a diamond ring for my wife, and despite the heavy crowd, our experience was excellent.

Mr. Shivam Chauhan assisted us, and his professionalism truly stood out. He patiently guided us through various designs, clearly explained diamond quality, grading, and pricing, and made the entire process easy to understand.

We also exchanged our old gold ring, and the process was handled with complete transparency—everything from weighing to explaining current gold rates and purity testing was done in front of us. This gave us a lot of confidence and trust.

Shivam’s friendly approach, knowledge, and dedication made our purchase smooth and memorable. We are extremely happy with our beautiful diamond ring and the overall experience.

Great service like this definitely makes customers want to return again!

Malabar Gold and Diamonds has 30,000+ intricate designs of jewellery handcrafted in gold, diamond, polki, precious gemstone, and platinum.

I went to Malabaar Andheri west branch, the salesman named Prasen showed us rings for  15mins. Then he handed over a 5% battery tab to check online and went away keeping us unattended. As we selected our ring. He went away to serve another customer and didn't return for almost 1hr. Finally as we were leaving he asked us to wait as he said he would giving discount. Finally after 2hrs he said he cannot give any discount. We wasted 4 hours in shop and were treated as if the salesman is doing us a favor.

Everyone please go to any other store but not Malabaar, if you value your time and self-esteem.
